storyCards.headline: Make Me Lose Control: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Eric Carmen's "Make Me Lose Control" reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Make Me Lose Control" is a song written and performed by singer-songwriter Eric Carmen and co-written with Dean Pitchford.

The song peaked at #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.
